profile.summary: A nonprofit arts and healing organization based in Oakland, California, doing business as The Center for ArtEsteem. It offers creative programs in schools and communities, public art murals, exhibitions, and professional development workshops. Its stated mission is to help people be self-aware and inspired through art, creativity, and education.

sources.title: Attitudinal Healing Connection Inc - ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer

review.notes: The artesteem.org contact and overview pages state the exact legal name and dba from the agenda, EIN 94-3178158, a West Oakland base, school-based arts programming and the contact details; ProPublica independently shows the same EIN in Oakland. The summary is neutral and supported.
